extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Compared with scaramuzzo_2020: different population (controlled ventilation vs pressure support) and period; no overlap. No registration number reported in this study.
unclear_items: Mild chronic pulmonary disease and Diabetes mellitus percentages in Table 1 are reported as 1% but the counts (3/30) imply 10%; recorded counts only.
Blinding was not feasible but not explicitly described in methods.
PEEP titration target is not a classic transpulmonary pressure target; coded as other.
Condition-level values for many physiologic outcomes not reported; only paired differences.
extraction_flags.general_notes: The paper reports a randomized crossover trial; all physiologic outcomes are paired within patients. Clinical outcomes (VFDs, mortality) are for the whole cohort and not attributable to a specific PEEP strategy. The ESM tables not available for exact condition-level values.
